description: Get the metadata for a single domain in the authenticated account: status, TLD, create date, expire date, security lock, WHOIS privacy, auto-renew, API access opt-in, and (optionally) labels. Returns an error with code `DOMAIN_NOT_FOUND` if the domain isn't in the account; the error's `account` field names the account the key belongs to, so a domain in a different account is easy to tell from a missing one.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name in the account, e.g. `example.com`

include_labels.description: Include user-defined domain labels in the response.

name: get_domain
